description: The falls: a low band of noise, the roar of water pouring over the lip, heard from reach metres away. The lip is kilometres long, a line source: its level falls 3 dB each time the distance doubles, from most at near metres. The air takes the highs over distance (absorption, in dB per km, at the frequencies given, at 20 °C and 70% humidity), so far off the falls are a rumble and near them a roar with a hiss. Louder while the boat falls. Distances in metres, frequencies in Hz, levels as gains.
